abstract: Invasive moles have been difficult to diagnose except at hysterectomy. Many patients with persistent gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) have been treated without ever demonstrating the site of the persistent trophoblastic focus. High resolution transvaginal sonography (TVS) has provided a technique of demonstrating very small uterine lesions, previously unsuspected by transabdominal sonography. The addition of colour flow Doppler further increased diagnostic sensitivity and provides another means of monitoring response to therapy. Three patients with persistent GTD, scanned by TVS and CFD (colour flow Doppler) performed as part of their metastatic work-up are presented. The only abnormalities detected were foci demonstrated within the myometrium that demonstrated increased flow on CFD. Single agent chemotherapy was commenced and the patients were monitored periodically through their course with repeat ultrasonography. After an initial lag period, the lesions decreased in size as the beta-HCG titres fell. An unsuspected adnexal mass was diagnosed on 1 patient, later proving to be a mature ovarian teratoma.
abstract_ja: 侵入奇胎は子宮摘出術時を除き診断が困難であった。多くの持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)患者は、持続性の栄養膜病巣の部位が示されないまま治療されてきた。高解像度経膣超音波検査(TVS)は、経腹超音波検査では以前は想定されなかった非常に小さな子宮病変を描出する手法を提供した。カラードップラー法(CFD)を加えることで診断感度がさらに向上し、治療反応のモニタリング手段ともなる。転移性精査の一環としてTVSとCFDで検査された持続性GTDの3例を提示する。検出された異常所見は、筋層内で血流増加を示す病巣のみであった。単剤化学療法を開始し、経過中は繰り返し超音波検査でモニタリングした。当初の遅延期間の後、β-hCG値の低下に伴い病変は縮小した。1例では、予期せぬ付属器腫瘤が診断され、後に成熟卵巣奇形腫と判明した。
